answer: 根据《Changing your enrolment》（马来西亚校区）：Units that are discontinued after the census date will not be backdated prior to the census date, or any other academic penalty date, unless University error can be demonstrated by the student.

points.text: 《Intermission (study leave)》· Step 2: When to apply（所有校区）
points.quote: If you apply for study leave after the census date, you’ll be charged for all enrolled units and receive a Withdrawn or Withdrawn Fail grade.
points.title: Intermission (study leave)

points.text: 《Add or withdraw from units》· Penalties for withdrawing late（所有校区）
points.quote: If you have to withdraw after the census date because of circumstances out of your control, you may be eligible for a WDN grade, a fee reversal, or both.
points.title: Add or withdraw from units

points.text: 《Fee reversal and Withdrawn grade (special circumstances)》· Fee reversal and Withdrawn grade (special circumstances)（所有校区）
points.quote: If you’ve experienced special circumstances that cause you to fail a unit or withdraw from a unit after the census date, you may be eligible to have your fees reversed, and your fail grade converted to a WDN grade.
points.title: Fee reversal and Withdrawn grade (special circumstances)
